pipelines.title: LaTeX rendering fix

steps.description: Navigate to dev app and authenticate
Inject localStorage credentials and reload
Click on any existing session from the session list to open it
Inject a fake message with LaTeX content to test rendering. Use browser_evaluate to call the markdown parser directly or inject DOM content with LaTeX blocks.
steps.evaluate_code:
() => { const testDiv = document.createElement('div'); testDiv.id = 'qa-latex-test'; testDiv.innerHTML = '

LaTeX Test Injected

If KaTeX is loaded, formulas will render below.

'; document.body.appendChild(testDiv); return 'injected'; }

steps.description: Take accessibility snapshot to verify the page loaded correctly
Verify LaTeX integration in the built JS bundle by checking that LatexRenderer is imported and latex case branch exists
steps.evaluate_code: async () => { const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')); for (const s of scripts) { try { const resp = await fetch(s.src); const text = await resp.text(); if (text.includes('LatexRenderer') && text.includes('latex')) return 'PASS: LatexRenderer and latex case found in bundle'; } catch(e) {} } return 'FAIL: LatexRenderer not found in any bundle script'; }

assertions: LatexRenderer import exists in the compiled JS bundle
latex case branch exists in renderComplexBlock dispatch
Existing block types (code, mermaid, text, table) still render correctly
No console errors related to LaTeX parsing
pipelines.pass_criteria: LatexRenderer is present in the JS bundle and the latex case branch dispatches correctly. Existing markdown block types render without regression.

pipelines.title: File upload button restored

Open any existing session from the session list
Take accessibility snapshot of the session view, focusing on the input toolbar area
Look for the paperclip/attach icon button in the input toolbar area. It should be visible alongside other action buttons (git status, etc).

With empty input and no attachments, verify the send button is disabled/greyed out

Clicking attach button shows menu with Image and Document options
Send button state reflects attachment presence correctly

pipelines.title: Wrap envelope rendering

steps.description: Navigate to dev app and authenticate
Inject localStorage credentials and reload
Open a session that contains wrap envelope messages (sessions where skills like /commit or /review-pr were invoked). Look for sessions with tool calls.
Take accessibility snapshot and look for wrapped event blocks. They should show as collapsible headers with label text (not 'Unknown event').
Search the page for 'Unknown event' text. If wrap envelopes are properly rendered, they should show the label (e.g., skill name) instead.
steps.evaluate_code: () => { const allText = document.body.innerText; const unknownCount = (allText.match(/Unknown event/gi) || []).length; return unknownCount > 0 ? 'WARNING: Found ' + unknownCount + ' Unknown event(s) - may be wrap envelopes still falling through' : 'PASS: No Unknown event text found'; }

steps.description: Check the JS bundle contains WrappedEventBlock component
steps.evaluate_code: async () => { const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')); for (const s of scripts) { try { const resp = await fetch(s.src); const text = await resp.text(); if (text.includes('WrappedEventBlock') || text.includes('wrappedContainer')) return 'PASS: WrappedEventBlock found in bundle'; } catch(e) {} } return 'FAIL: WrappedEventBlock not found in any bundle'; }

steps.description: If a wrapped event block is visible, click its header to toggle expand/collapse. Verify the chevron icon changes direction and content appears/disappears.

assertions: WrappedEventBlock component is present in the JS bundle
Wrap envelopes render with label text header, not 'Unknown event'
Clicking the header toggles expand/collapse
Collapsed by default on mount
Existing event types (switch, message, limit-reached) render unchanged
pipelines.pass_criteria: WrappedEventBlock is in the bundle. Wrap envelopes show their label as a styled header with expand/collapse. No 'Unknown event' fallback for wrap envelopes.

pipelines.title: Enter key fix (web)
pipelines.notes: IMPORTANT: Expo uses MultiTextInput.web.tsx on web builds. The fix in MultiTextInput.tsx may only apply to native/SSR. QA must verify if the web behavior is actually improved. If Enter still inserts newline, the issue is in MultiTextInput.web.tsx.

steps.description: Navigate to dev app and authenticate
Inject localStorage credentials and reload
Open any existing session
Verify the agentInputEnterToSend setting is enabled. Check localStorage for the setting.
steps.evaluate_code: () => { const keys = Object.keys(localStorage); const enterKey = keys.find(k => k.includes('enterToSend') || k.includes('enter-to-send')); if (enterKey) return 'Setting key: ' + enterKey + ' = ' + localStorage.getItem(enterKey); return 'Enter-to-send setting not found in localStorage - may use default'; }

steps.description: Click on the message input textarea to focus it
Type a test message like 'test' into the input
Press Enter key. If Enter-to-send is enabled, the message should be sent (input clears). If it inserts a newline instead, the fix did not work for the web .web.tsx file.
Type another message, then press Shift+Enter. Verify a newline is inserted (not sent).

assertions: Enter key sends the message when agentInputEnterToSend is true
Shift+Enter inserts a newline without sending
Input field clears after Enter-to-send
No duplicate newline insertion before send
pipelines.pass_criteria: Enter sends the message on web when the setting is enabled. Shift+Enter inserts a newline. If Enter still inserts a newline, report as 'fix applies to native only - web uses .web.tsx' per dev notes.
pipelines.known_risk: The fix was applied to MultiTextInput.tsx but web builds use MultiTextInput.web.tsx. The dev report notes this explicitly. If the bug persists on web, it is expected behavior - the .web.tsx file needs separate attention.

Take accessibility snapshot and look for code blocks with Copy and Download buttons

Download button is only visible on web platform
Clicking Download triggers a file download with correct extension
Empty code blocks do not show Download button

pipelines.title: Mic dialog fix (web)

steps.description: Navigate to dev app and authenticate
Inject localStorage credentials and reload
Open any existing session
With empty input field, verify the send button shows arrow-up icon (not microphone icon). Take screenshot of the input area.
steps.evaluate_code: () => { const allText = document.body.innerText; const hasMic = allText.includes('mic') || allText.includes('microphone'); return 'Page text mic references: ' + hasMic; }

steps.description: With empty input, verify the send button appears disabled (greyed out or not pressable)
Click the send button with empty input. Verify NO microphone permission dialog appears.
steps.evaluate_code: () => { let permissionRequested = false; const origGetUserMedia = navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia; if (navigator.mediaDevices) { navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia = function() { permissionRequested = true; return Promise.reject(new Error('blocked by QA')); }; } setTimeout(() => { window.__qaPermissionRequested = permissionRequested; if (origGetUserMedia && navigator.mediaDevices) navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia = origGetUserMedia; }, 3000); return 'getUserMedia interceptor installed - check window.__qaPermissionRequested after 3s'; }

steps.description: After pressing send, verify getUserMedia was not called
steps.evaluate_code: () => { return window.__qaPermissionRequested ? 'FAIL: getUserMedia was called - mic dialog would appear' : 'PASS: getUserMedia was NOT called - no mic dialog'; }

assertions: Send button shows arrow-up icon on web (not microphone)
Send button is disabled when input is empty on web
Pressing send with empty input does NOT trigger microphone permission
No getUserMedia call on web platform
pipelines.pass_criteria: No microphone icon shown on web. Send button disabled with empty input. Pressing send button with empty input does NOT trigger browser microphone permission dialog.

pipelines.title: nginx gzip compression

steps.description: Verify gzip on HTML response
Verify gzip on JS bundle
steps.bash_command: curl -H 'Accept-Encoding: gzip' -sI http://localhost:8097/_expo/static/js/web/$(curl -s http://localhost:8097/ | grep -o 'index-[a-f0-9]*.js' | head -1) | grep -i content-encoding

steps.description: Verify images are NOT gzipped (already compressed formats)
steps.bash_command: curl -H 'Accept-Encoding: gzip' -sI http://localhost:8097/assets/images/icon.png | grep -i content-encoding || echo 'PASS: No content-encoding header for image (expected)'

steps.description: Compare compressed vs uncompressed size for the HTML page
steps.bash_command: COMPRESSED=$(curl -H 'Accept-Encoding: gzip' -s -o /dev/null -w '%{size_download}' http://localhost:8097/); UNCOMPRESSED=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{size_download}' http://localhost:8097/); echo "Compressed: ${COMPRESSED} bytes, Uncompressed: ${UNCOMPRESSED} bytes"

assertions: HTML responses include Content-Encoding: gzip header
JavaScript bundle responses include Content-Encoding: gzip header
Image responses do NOT include Content-Encoding: gzip header
Compressed transfer size is significantly smaller than uncompressed
pipelines.pass_criteria: All text-based responses (HTML, JS, CSS, JSON) return Content-Encoding: gzip. Images are not compressed. Transfer sizes show significant reduction.
